I replied to Pree's correction in #central-team, in a thread on their message: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

I also posted the correction in the thread from this morning, under my earlier reply that said Dock 23. That way nobody reading that thread is left with the wrong location. I didn't do anything else, since they said no action was needed.
